evals.prompt: Create a Molecule scenario to test the evaluate role for STIG on Cisco IOS. It should use mock data with 2 access ports and 1 trunk port, and verify that stig_results is populated correctly.
evals.expected_output: A complete Molecule scenario under extensions/molecule/evaluate-stig-ios/ with molecule.yaml (delegated driver, local connection), prepare.yaml (mock port data), converge.yaml (include evaluate role), and verify.yaml (assert stig_results).
assertions: Scenario directory is named evaluate-stig-ios (follows <role>-<framework>-<platform> convention)
molecule.yaml uses default/delegated driver with ansible_connection: local
prepare.yaml sets compliance_access_ports and compliance_trunk_ports with mock data
verify.yaml asserts stig_results is defined and contains valid statuses
Variables use compliance.framework and compliance.platform (not flat prefix)

evals.prompt: Write a Molecule test for the remediate role that includes idempotency checking.
evals.expected_output: A scenario with idempotence in the test_sequence, prepare.yaml seeding stig_results with open findings.
assertions: prepare.yaml pre-populates stig_results with at least one open finding
